name: CLAVIS-M2

views: DINOv2 ViT-L/14 (same support/calibration split, candidate sets, m, n0)

definition: Per view: candidate memory = stream samples with p_all <= eps_cand (appended after their batch is scored).
Per view: p_C = conformal p-value of g_C = d - (r_C - med_all)/mad_all against the calibration shots' g_C under the same candidate memory.
Per view: scoring memory = stream samples with p_C <= eps_admit; p_t = conformal p-value of g = d - (r_M - med_all)/mad_all (CLAVIS-M c1 with this memory).
Score = S_final * p_t(B/14) * p_t(L/14). No training, no weights.

selection_on_dev1.explored: TINS seed gating / visual seeds (no gain after fusion), text-based and joint admission (worse), self-admission, within-batch memory (+0.1), class-conditional memory offsets (worse after fusion), backbones B/L/g (L best, g worse than L), two-stage admission eps_cand in {0.2,0.3,0.4,0.5}, two-view products
selection_on_dev1.choice: eps_cand = 0.30 (middle of the grid, largest value keeping far within the margin for B/14 alone), same values for both views, L/14 over g/14 (g/14 weaker on dev1)
